claim: In SMILES-based molecular VAEs with continuous latent space, constraints such as synthesizability and solubility can be approximated by low-rank linear subspaces to enable constrained latent optimization for improving feasible-hit sample efficiency (hits per oracle query) on constrained molecular design problems from the GuacaMol similarity tasks (e.g., Aripiprazole, Tamoxifen, Celecoxib with additional constraints) relative to black-box Bayesian optimization baselines under matched query budgets.

experiment_recipes.goal: Verify that the GuacaMol constrained similarity tasks are executable and contain feasible-hit definitions for the named targets
experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Canonicalize/standardize molecules with RDKit/MolVS/InChI; Compute Tanimoto with Morgan/ECFP4 (radius=2)
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: For each named GuacaMol similarity task target, Aripiprazole, Tamoxifen, and Celecoxib, the benchmark configuration must specify: a numeric hit rule based on the GuacaMol similarity oracle, a numeric synthesizability constraint using SA Score, and a numeric solubility-related constraint operationalized by the task configuration or by logP. After RDKit standardization, at least one valid molecule in the GuacaMol candidate/training pool must satisfy the full feasible-hit definition for each target. If any target lacks a numeric feasible-hit definition or has zero feasible hits under the defined constraints, the claim is not executable for that task and is refuted for the named GuacaMol setting.
constraints_not_enforced: Any additional constraints implied by the truncated claim text after 'with addi' are not enforceable unless present in the benchmark configuration
True experimental aqueous solubility is not enforced unless supplied by the GuacaMol task; logP is only an allowed solubility-related proxy
experiment_recipes.rationale: The claim is about improving feasible-hit sample efficiency, so the benchmark must first define feasible hits and contain nonempty feasible regions before latent optimization can be meaningfully tested.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Train and validate the continuous-latent SMILES VAE required by the claim
experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Teacher forcing for SMILES sequence model training; Randomized SMILES augmentation; Bayesian optimization in latent space of generative models
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Train the SMILES VAE on the standardized GuacaMol training split using five random seeds. On a held-out GuacaMol validation split, the apparatus passes only if mean exact canonical-SMILES reconstruction accuracy is at least 50%, mean decoded validity from posterior samples is at least 80%, and mean decoded validity from prior latent samples is at least 60%. If any of these three thresholds is missed, the VAE is not a valid apparatus for testing constrained continuous-latent optimization and the headline claim is refuted for this implementation.
depends_on: Verify that the GuacaMol constrained similarity tasks are executable and contain feasible-hit definitions for the named targets
experiment_recipes.rationale: A SMILES VAE with unusable reconstruction or invalid decoding cannot support the claimed continuous latent optimization; validity and reconstruction are standard VAE apparatus checks in molecular generation.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Test whether synthesizability and solubility constraints are approximable by low-rank linear subspaces in the SMILES VAE latent space
experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Gaussian process surrogate for property/latent optimization; Constrained Bayesian optimization
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Encode the GuacaMol validation molecules with the trained SMILES VAE, compute SA Score and the configured solubility/logP constraint value, and fit rank-k linear latent predictors/subspaces with k in {1,2,4,8,16} and k <= latent_dim/4. The low-rank apparatus passes only if, for both SA Score and solubility/logP on a held-out test split, some k <= latent_dim/4 achieves test R^2 at least 90% of the full-rank linear latent model's test R^2, test RMSE no worse than 110% of the full-rank linear model's RMSE, and successful property-constraint classification at least 90% of the full-rank model's success rate. If no such k exists for either constraint, the claim that these constraints can be approximated by low-rank linear subspaces is refuted.
constraints_not_enforced: Any unobserved additional constraint from the truncated claim
depends_on: Train and validate the continuous-latent SMILES VAE required by the claim
experiment_recipes.rationale: The claim specifically depends on a low-rank linear approximation to feasibility constraints; comparing low-rank latent predictors against full-rank linear predictors directly tests that presupposition.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Measure whether low-rank constrained latent optimization improves feasible-hit sample efficiency on the named GuacaMol similarity tasks
experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Constrained Bayesian optimization; Bayesian optimization in latent space; Sample-efficiency evaluation with capped oracle budget; Report multiple runs with different seeds
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: For Aripiprazole, Tamoxifen, and Celecoxib GuacaMol similarity tasks, run 20 independent seeds with the same oracle budget per method. Compare: low-rank constrained latent BO in the SMILES VAE latent space versus unconstrained SMILES VAE latent BO and random latent sampling with the same decoding and standardization pipeline. A molecule counts as a hit only if it is valid, unique within the run, satisfies the task similarity-hit rule, satisfies the SA Score constraint, and satisfies the configured solubility/logP constraint. The claim passes only if low-rank constrained latent BO has strictly higher mean feasible hits per oracle query than unconstrained latent BO and random latent sampling on all three named tasks, with paired one-sided bootstrap 95% confidence intervals for the difference excluding 0 for each comparison. Failure on any named task refutes the headline claim as stated for the GuacaMol examples.
constraints_not_enforced: Any additional constraints implied by the truncated claim text after 'with addi' unless explicitly present in the task configuration
True aqueous solubility if only logP is available
depends_on: Test whether synthesizability and solubility constraints are approximable by low-rank linear subspaces in the SMILES VAE latent space
experiment_recipes.rationale: This is the direct test of the asserted benefit: feasible hits per oracle query under the claimed low-rank constrained latent optimization on the named GuacaMol similarity tasks.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Check that any sample-efficiency gain is caused by the learned low-rank feasibility subspace rather than by oracle budget, decoding validity, or generic BO effects
experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Constrained Bayesian optimization; Acquisition functions and optimization for BO; Report multiple runs with different seeds
metrics: AUC Top-10 (Top-K area under curve vs oracle calls)
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Repeat the headline experiment with four matched-budget ablations: learned low-rank subspace, randomly oriented subspace of the same rank, full-rank linear constraint model, and no constraint model. The learned low-rank method passes the mechanism control only if its mean feasible hits per oracle query is strictly greater than the random same-rank subspace and no-constraint ablations on all three named tasks, with paired bootstrap 95% confidence intervals for each difference excluding 0, while decoded validity differs by no more than 10 percentage points from the ablations. If random same-rank or no-constraint optimization matches or exceeds the learned low-rank method on any named task, the low-rank-subspace mechanism is refuted.
constraints_not_enforced: External non-GuacaMol drug-discovery endpoints such as docking score or pIC50
Any additional truncated-claim constraints not present in the executable task definition
depends_on: Measure whether low-rank constrained latent optimization improves feasible-hit sample efficiency on the named GuacaMol similarity tasks
experiment_recipes.rationale: A mechanism-specific ablation is required because constrained BO, decoding validity, or rank reduction alone could otherwise explain apparent gains.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

baseline_recipes.goal: Test whether synthesizability and solubility constraints are approximable by a low-rank linear latent subspace
baseline_recipes.dataset: Encoded GuacaMol train/validation/test molecules from the validated SMILES VAE, labeled with SA score and ESOL/RDKit logS
baseline_recipes.model: Validated SMILES VAE plus linear low-rank constraint model
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Learn a rank-k affine projection U^T z, with k <= ceil(0.1d), and linear classifiers/regressors in that projected space for SA <= 4.0, logS >= -4.0, and their conjunction
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: Use scaffold-disjoint validation/test splits. Fit k in {2,4,8,16,...} subject to k <= ceil(0.1d). Compare against full-dimensional logistic/linear models and rank-matched random projections.
metrics: AUC gap versus full-dimensional linear model
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Pass only if there exists k <= ceil(0.1d) such that on the held-out test split: joint-feasibility ROC-AUC >= 0.75, both individual constraint ROC-AUCs >= 0.75, precision >= 0.80 at recall >= 0.50 for joint feasibility, the joint-feasibility AUC is within 0.03 of the full-dimensional linear model, and the joint-feasibility AUC exceeds the mean rank-matched random-projection AUC by >= 0.10. Failure refutes the claim that these constraints are well approximated by a low-rank linear latent subspace under this VAE.
constraints_not_enforced: hits per oracle query on constrained GuacaMol similarity tasks
depends_on: Build and validate the SMILES VAE with a continuous latent space used by the claimed constrained latent optimizer
baseline_recipes.rationale: The mechanism in the claim requires more than a trained VAE: the chemical constraints must be predictable from a low-dimensional linear latent projection. Held-out scaffold splits and comparisons to full-dimensional and random projections test whether the low-rank linear structure is real rather than overfitting.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Directly test whether low-rank constrained latent optimization improves feasible-hit sample efficiency over black-box Bayesian optimization baselines under matched query budgets
baseline_recipes.dataset: GuacaMol Aripiprazole, Tamoxifen, and Celecoxib similarity tasks with added constraints SA <= 4.0 and logS >= -4.0
baseline_recipes.model: Validated SMILES VAE with validated low-rank linear constraint subspace
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Constrained latent optimization in the learned low-rank subspace using a constrained acquisition function; decode candidates to SMILES; count every oracle-evaluated valid or invalid candidate against the query budget
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: For each target and each of 20 random seeds, use the same initial 100 evaluated molecules for all methods and a total budget of 1000 oracle queries including initialization. Compare against matched-budget black-box Bayesian optimization baselines that do not use the VAE latent subspace, e.g. GP/Tanimoto BO over Morgan fingerprints, random-forest or TPE BO over fingerprints/descriptors, and batch expected-improvement BO. Deduplicate molecules; only first oracle evaluation of a unique decoded molecule can count as a hit, but all proposed molecules consume queries.
metrics: paired bootstrap confidence interval of hits-per-query ratio
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Pass only if, for each of Aripiprazole, Tamoxifen, and Celecoxib, the low-rank constrained latent optimizer has higher mean hits per oracle query than every black-box BO baseline and the lower bound of the one-sided paired 95% bootstrap confidence interval for the hits-per-query ratio versus the best baseline is > 1.0. If this condition fails on any named task, the headline claim is refuted.
depends_on: Test whether synthesizability and solubility constraints are approximable by a low-rank linear latent subspace
baseline_recipes.rationale: This is the direct sample-efficiency test promised by the claim: same tasks, same constraints, same oracle budget, same initialization, and the primary metric is feasible hits per oracle query relative to black-box Bayesian optimization.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Check that any headline improvement is caused by the learned low-rank constraint mechanism rather than by VAE decoding, query accounting, random chance, or weak baselines
baseline_recipes.dataset: Same constrained GuacaMol Aripiprazole, Tamoxifen, and Celecoxib tasks as the headline recipe
baseline_recipes.model: Validated SMILES VAE and low-rank constraint model
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Ablations and robustness checks for the low-rank constrained latent optimizer
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: Repeat the headline protocol with: rank-matched random subspaces, unconstrained latent optimization, full-dimensional linear constrained latent optimization, random latent search, random GuacaMol-library search, and learned-subspace rank sweep over k. Also repeat with budgets 250, 500, 1000, and 2000 queries while keeping all methods budget-matched.
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Pass only if at the 1000-query budget the learned low-rank constrained optimizer has a lower 95% paired-bootstrap hits-per-query ratio > 1.10 versus rank-matched random subspaces, > 1.10 versus random latent search, and > 1.00 versus unconstrained latent optimization on the pooled three-task result; its constraint-violation rate among proposed valid molecules is at least 25% lower than unconstrained latent optimization; and no budget in {250,500,1000,2000} reverses the headline conclusion versus the best black-box BO baseline on the pooled result. Failure indicates the headline result is likely an artifact or does not specifically support the claimed low-rank constraint mechanism.
constraints_not_enforced: This control does not by itself establish the main comparison on each individual named task; that is enforced in the headline recipe
depends_on: Directly test whether low-rank constrained latent optimization improves feasible-hit sample efficiency over black-box Bayesian optimization baselines under matched query budgets
baseline_recipes.rationale: Controls are needed because VAE-based methods can appear better due to decoder priors, invalid-query filtering, weak baselines, or lucky seeds. Random-subspace, unconstrained, full-dimensional, random-search, rank-sweep, and budget-sweep controls isolate whether the learned low-rank constraint subspace is actually responsible for improved feasible-hit efficiency.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline
